Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunxi Langting Ting (雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄): in his volume-four general address, Yunxi Langting Ting instructs beginning students to chew over an unbreakable ready-made sentence repeatedly until old masters' tongues can no longer deceive them.
